notes.title: I AM RABBT 1.1
notes.content:
[Update 1.1]

- Added Mouse Sensitivity Adjustment Feature
You can now adjust the mouse sensitivity by accessing the Options menu through ESC while in the game.

- Improved Mouse Pointer Visiblity
We've made enhancements to the visibility of the mouse pointer during gameplay. Now you can play the game without any confusion caused by the mouse pointer.

- Scarecrow Movement Speed Reduced
We've decreased the movement speed of the scarecrow that used to make it difficult for the rabbit on the first stage.

- Reduced Cart Slippage
The cart on the second stage that you used to abandon while carrying the rabbit can now be controlled more steadily.

- Other bug fix


This is the updates we've prepared this time.
In the next update, we will be bringing you new challenges, so please stay tuned!
